label: early original-phase positions 2-4, favoring tokens p r l y n 3 c i x k h
explanation: Fires only during the original (input) phase, at steps 2-4 (t=3 alone carries 66% of mass, t=2 24%, t=4 10%); never at t=0, essentially never at t>=5, the delimiter, or any copy step. Within that window it is token-selective: strongest for in_tok p, r, l, y, n, 3, c, i (also x, k, h), and favors first occurrences of a token (in_first=1 carries 90% of mass). Previous token i boosts it (top examples are ...i [p/r/y]). Position alone (t in 2..4) gives recall 0.996 but precision 0.23; adding the token set gives dev F1 0.54, mass recall 0.82. The token preference is graded rather than a clean set, so precision stays incomplete.
